name: helal-video-converter
description: Local-first Windows desktop video converter powered by Electron, React, TypeScript, FFmpeg, and FFprobe.
author: Helal

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && node scripts/verify-win-binaries.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:all && node scripts/verify-win-binaries.mjs && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:win:all: npm run build:all && node scripts/verify-win-binaries.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
